 bracket indexing with a logical expression
    Bonnie Dixon <bonnie...@gmail.com> Sep 13 04:47PM -0700  

    Hi D-RUG folks.
     
    I have noticed something odd when using bracket indexing with a logical
    expression to select a subset of elements, and I am wondering if anyone can
    explain this behavior.
     
    If there are missing values in a vector, then these seem to be included
    when selecting a subset this way.
     
    > x <- c(5, NA, 7, 2, 3, NA, 8)
    > x
    [1] 5 NA 7 2 3 NA 8
    > x < 4
    [1] FALSE NA FALSE TRUE TRUE NA FALSE
    > x[x < 4]
    [1] NA 2 3 NA
    > x[x == 3]
    [1] NA 3 NA
     
    However, when reassigning the selected subset of elements to a different
    value, the missing values do not seem to "take" the reassignment.
     
    > x[x < 4] <- 0
    > x
    [1] 5 NA 7 0 0 NA 8
     
    Is this the expected behavior? It seems inconsistent.
     
    Thanks.
     
    Bonnie
